name: Boku to Sensei no Nyuuin Seikatsu
original_name: ぼくと先生の乳淫せいかつ
source:
Takehaya Souma was on his way to college when he was involved in a traffic accident and lost consciousness. When he came to, he found himself in a hospital bed with a stranger standing beside him.

"I'm Isami, your doctor. Takehaya Souma... do you know who you are?"

Apparently, I got hit by Dr Isami's car while I was in a hurry.
When I tried to get up, I felt pain in my left leg.

"It usually takes two to three weeks for a broken leg to heal. Though you may have acted carelessly, I caused the accident, so I will do what I can to make up for it."

"What you can, you say? Well... I don't know if this is something I can say to someone I just met."

"What is it? If it's something I can do, please don't hesitate to say it."

"Please, show me your boobs! I'd love to touch and suck them... a-and, and..."

"Takehaya... It seems you need a special examination."

Dr Isami looks down at Souma, as if she's looking at trash.

Thus began Souma's wonderful life of asking a doctor with a sadistic streak to do all sorts of things for him.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097910]Steam[/url]]
translation:
竹早相马在上大学的路上遭遇车祸，失去了知觉。当他醒来时，发现自己躺在医院的病床上，旁边站着一个陌生人。

“我是你的医生勇。竹早相马……你知道你是谁吗？”

显然，我是在匆忙中被Isami博士的车撞到的。
当我试图站起来时，我感到左腿疼痛。

“腿断了一般要两三周才能痊愈，虽然是你不小心，但事故是我造成的，所以我会尽力弥补。”

“你说你能做什么？嗯……我不知道这是否是我可以对刚认识的人说的话。”

“什么事？如果是我能做的事，请尽管说。”

“请让我看看你的胸部！我很想触摸并吮吸它们……a-and，and…”

“竹早……看来你需要进行特殊检查了。”

Isami博士低头看着相马，就好像她在看垃圾一样。

相马拜托有虐待狂倾向的医生为他做各种各样的事情，从此开始了他的奇妙人生。
